notes: The registered C row requires level 1 at POS_STANDING, and the Go registry preserves the authoritative entry gate (R1/R2/R5e).
The shared POS_STANDING dispatcher rejection is owned by the existing flip position-gate vehicle (R2/R5b/R5c).
IS_MOUNTED returns Dismount first! before the normal attempt text or number(1,101) roll (R1/R3/R5e).
Every reachable roll outcome emits C's unconditional Okay line, with no invented toggle or failure text (R1/R3/R4/R5e).
The handler never parses the command remainder; trailing words do not alter its message or roll path (R1/R2/R3/R5e).
A successful roll installs one SKILL_SNEAK/AFF_SNEAK affect with GET_LEVEL duration after replacing prior sneak/stealth affects (R3/R5e).
A failed reroll still clears both prior affects and leaves no AFF_SNEAK state; C does not toggle off with a separate line (R1/R3/R4/R5e).
The mounted early return consumes no random draw, preserving C's RNG stream boundary (R3/R5e).
